landscape.label: What Drives the Price
landscape.title: What drives ADU cost in Culver City
landscape.say: What drives the price in Culver City? Pre-approved plans: 468, 637 or 806 sq ft new-build layouts. Baldwin Hills slopes: retaining walls & longer utility runs. Fire zone: blair Hills & Culver Crest. Water provider: lADWP or Golden State Water. Older garages: foundation & framing checks. Finishes: kitchens & baths move the total.

landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Culver City ADU rules to know

tiles.s: The most a city can require

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than four-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. ADUs of seven hundred fifty square feet or less skip impact fees. And Culver City offers three pre-approved ADU plans for new builds.
landscape.say: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than 4-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has 60 days to act on a complete application. ADUs of 750 square feet or less skip impact fees. And Culver City offers three pre-approved ADU plans for new builds.
